Name: Country code
Description: Country as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, referencing the managed Country reference entity.

Name: Currency code
Description: Currency as an ISO 4217 alphabetic code, referencing the managed Currency reference entity.

Name: Language code
Description: Language as a two-letter ISO 639 code (formerly ISO 639-1), referencing the managed Language reference entity.

Name: Date
Description: Calendar date in ISO 8601 extended format (YYYY-MM-DD) when exchanged as text.

Name: Timestamp
Description: Date and time with explicit UTC offset, ISO 8601 extended format.

Name: Phone number
Description: Telephone number normalised to E.164 (plus sign, country code, national number, max 15 digits). Personal when it belongs to a natural person.

Name: Email address
Description: Email address. Personal when it identifies a natural person, including professional addresses such as firstname.lastname@example.com.

Name: Person name
Description: Given name, family name or full name of a natural person.

Name: Postal address
Description: Postal address lines, city, postal code and country (country as COUNTRY_CODE). Personal when it is the address of a natural person.
Example: 1000 Rue Sherbrooke O, Montreal QC H3A 3G4, CA

Name: Date of birth
Description: Date of birth of a natural person.

Name: Government identifier
Description: Government-issued personal identifier (social security, national ID, passport, driver's licence number). Sensitive personal information under CCPA/CPRA.

Name: Health data
Description: Data concerning the physical or mental health of a natural person (GDPR Art. 4(15), special category under Art. 9).

Name: IBAN
Description: International bank account number. Personal data when the account holder is a natural person.

Name: Legal entity identifier
Description: 20-character legal entity identifier of an organisation, issued by an LEI issuer accredited by GLEIF.

Name: VAT or tax registration number
Description: Tax registration number of an organisation (VAT, GST/HST, EIN), stored without spaces, with its issuing country.

Name: Organisation name
Description: Registered legal name or trading name of an organisation.

Name: GTIN
Description: GS1 Global Trade Item Number (8, 12, 13 or 14 digits) identifying a trade item.

Name: Product description
Description: Consumer-facing product name or description, held per language (ISO 639) and used on labels, catalogues and e-commerce.
Example: en: Organic oat drink 1 L / fr: Boisson d'avoine biologique 1 L

Name: Monetary amount
Description: Amount with its ISO 4217 currency held in a separate CURRENCY_CODE attribute.

Name: Source record identifier
Description: Identifier of a record in its source system, kept for lineage and cross-referencing.

Name: Free-text comment
Description: Unstructured comment entered by a user. Must not be used to store personal or sensitive data that has its own attribute.
Example: Customer asked to be called after 5 pm

Name: National Drug Code
Description: Pharma extension. FDA National Drug Code in its 10-digit hyphenated 4-4-2, 5-3-2 or 5-4-1 form.

Name: National Provider Identifier
Description: Pharma extension. 10-digit NPI of a US health care provider; the last digit is a Luhn check digit computed with the 80840 prefix. Personal data when the provider is an individual.

Name: HCP state licence number
Description: Pharma extension. Licence number of a healthcare professional with its issuing state or authority.

Name: Medicinal Product Identifier
Description: Pharma extension. IDMP Medicinal Product Identifier (ISO 11615) assigned by the regulatory authority of the jurisdiction.

Name: Pharmaceutical Product Identifier
Description: Pharma extension. IDMP Pharmaceutical Product Identifier (ISO 11616) derived from substance(s), strength and dose form.

Name: Transfer of value
Description: Pharma extension. Payment or other transfer of value to a covered recipient, reportable to CMS Open Payments.
